connectionSpecification.description: Reads projects, the configured project, its issues and events, and the organization's releases from the Sentry API.

auth_token.description: Organization or user auth token with the scopes project:read, event:read and org:read, sent as a Bearer token.
auth_token.title: Auth token

hostname.description: Host name of the Sentry instance, without https://: sentry.io, an EU region host such as de.sentry.io, or a self-hosted Sentry.
hostname.title: Host name

project.description: Slug of the project whose issues and events are read.
project.title: Project

start_date.description: Issues last seen, events received and releases created before it are not read. Default 1900-01-01T00:00:00Z, everything the instance keeps.
start_date.title: Start date

connectionSpecification.title: Sentry Source Spec
